metrics.description: This metric shows the number of incoming connections from clients to the database server. Darker colors indicate higher relative values.

job.template: CURRENT_CONNECTIONS = data("gauge.connections.current", filter=filter("plugin", "mongo")  and (not filter("cluster", "*")) {{#filter}} and {{{filter}}}{{/filter}}, extrapolation="last_value", maxExtrapolations=2).mean(by=["host"])

metrics.description: This metric shows total number of documents across all collections. Darker colors indicate higher relative values.

job.template: TOTAL_DOCUMENTS = data("gauge.objects", filter=filter("plugin", "mongo")  and (not filter("cluster", "*")) {{#filter}} and {{{filter}}}{{/filter}}, extrapolation="last_value", maxExtrapolations=2).mean(by=["host"]))

metrics.description: This metric shows the average time to write data to disk (ms). This metric is only available when MMAPv1 is enabled. (MMAPv1 is not supported in MongoDB version > 4.2). Darker colors indicate higher relative values.

job.template: BACKGROUND_FLUSH_TIME = data("gauge.backgroundFlushing.average_ms", filter=filter("plugin", "mongo") and (not filter("cluster", "*")) {{#filter}} and {{{filter}}}{{/filter}}, extrapolation="last_value", maxExtrapolations=2).mean(by=["host"])

metrics.description: This metric shows the total size of data (bytes). Darker colors indicate higher relative values.

job.template: TOTAL_DATA_SIZE = data("gauge.dataSize", filter=filter("plugin", "mongo")  and (not filter("cluster", "*")) {{#filter}} and {{{filter}}}{{/filter}}, extrapolation="last_value", maxExtrapolations=2).mean(by=["host"]).sum().scale(1024).scale(1024)

metrics.description: This metric shows total number of deletes since last restart. Darker colors indicate higher relative values.

job.template: TOTAL_DELETE_PER_SEC = data("counter.opcounters.delete", filter=filter("plugin", "mongo")  and (not filter("cluster", "*")) {{#filter}} and {{{filter}}}{{/filter}}, extrapolation="last_value", maxExtrapolations=2).mean(by=["host"])

metrics.description: This metric shows the total number of active client connections performing writes. Darker colors indicate higher relative values.

job.template:
TOTAL_LOCK_ACTIVECLIENTS_READERS = data("gauge.globalLock.activeClients.readers", filter=filter("plugin", "mongo") {{#filter}} and {{{filter}}}{{/filter}}, extrapolation="last_value", maxExtrapolations=2).sum(by=["host"])
TOTAL_LOCK_ACTIVECLIENTS_WRITERS = data("gauge.globalLock.activeClients.writers", filter=filter("plugin", "mongo") {{#filter}} and {{{filter}}}{{/filter}}, extrapolation="last_value", maxExtrapolations=2).sum(by=["host"])
TOTAL_LOCK_ACTIVECLIENTS_OPERATIONS=(TOTAL_LOCK_ACTIVECLIENTS_READERS+TOTAL_LOCK_ACTIVECLIENTS_WRITERS)

metrics.description: This metric shows total number of read operations currently in queue. Darker colors indicate higher relative values.

job.template:
TOTAL_CURRENT_QUEUE_READERS = data("gauge.globalLock.currentQueue.readers", filter=filter("plugin", "mongo")  and (not filter("cluster", "*")) {{#filter}} and {{{filter}}}{{/filter}}, extrapolation="last_value", maxExtrapolations=2).mean(by=["host"])
TOTAL_CURRENT_QUEUE_WRITERS = data("gauge.globalLock.currentQueue.writers", filter=filter("plugin", "mongo")  and (not filter("cluster", "*")) {{#filter}} and {{{filter}}}{{/filter}}, extrapolation="last_value", maxExtrapolations=2).mean(by=["host"])
TOTAL_LOCK_QUEUE_OPERATIONS = (TOTAL_CURRENT_QUEUE_READERS + TOTAL_CURRENT_QUEUE_WRITERS)

metrics.description: This metric shows total heap size used by the mongod process (bytes). Darker colors indicate higher relative values.

job.template: TOTAL_HEAP_USAGE = data("gauge.extra_info.heap_usage_byte", filter=filter("plugin", "mongo")  and (not filter("cluster", "*")) {{#filter}} and {{{filter}}}{{/filter}}, extrapolation="last_value").mean(by=["host"])

metrics.description: This metric shows total size of indexes (bytes). Darker colors indicate higher relative values.

job.template: TOTAL_INDEX_SIZE = data("gauge.indexSize", filter=filter("plugin", "mongo")  and (not filter("cluster", "*")) {{#filter}} and {{{filter}}}{{/filter}}, extrapolation="last_value", maxExtrapolations=2).mean(by=["host"]).sum().scale(1024).scale(1024)

metrics.description: This metric shows total number of mutations/sec (inserts and updates) since last restart. Darker colors indicate higher relative values.

job.template:
TOTAL_INSERT_PER_SEC = data("counter.opcounters.insert", filter=filter("plugin", "mongo")  and (not filter("cluster", "*")) {{#filter}} and {{{filter}}}{{/filter}}, extrapolation="last_value", maxExtrapolations=2).mean(by=["host"])
TOTAL_UPDATE_PER_SEC = data("counter.opcounters.update", filter=filter("plugin", "mongo")  and (not filter("cluster", "*")) {{#filter}} and {{{filter}}}{{/filter}}, extrapolation="last_value", maxExtrapolations=2).mean(by=["host"])
TOTAL_MUTATIONS_PER_SEC = (TOTAL_INSERT_PER_SEC + TOTAL_UPDATE_PER_SEC)

metrics.description: This metric shows total amount of network IO bytes/sec transferred by the database server. Darker colors indicate higher relative values.

job.template:
NETWORK_BYTES_IN = data("counter.network.bytesIn", filter=filter("plugin", "mongo")  and (not filter("cluster", "*")) {{#filter}} and {{{filter}}}{{/filter}}, extrapolation="last_value", maxExtrapolations=2).mean(by=["host"])
NETWORK_BYTES_OUT = data("counter.network.bytesOut", filter=filter("plugin", "mongo")  and (not filter("cluster", "*")) {{#filter}} and {{{filter}}}{{/filter}}, extrapolation="last_value", maxExtrapolations=2).mean(by=["host"])
NETWORK_BYTES_IN_OUT = (NETWORK_BYTES_IN + NETWORK_BYTES_OUT)

metrics.description: This metric shows total amount of non-mapped memory (bytes). Darker colors indicate higher relative values.

job.template:
TOTAL_VIRTUAl_MEMORY = data("gauge.mem.virtual", filter=filter("plugin", "mongo")  and (not filter("cluster", "*")) {{#filter}} and {{{filter}}}{{/filter}}, extrapolation="last_value", maxExtrapolations=2).mean(by=["host"])
TOTAL_MAPPED_MEMORY = data("gauge.mem.mapped", filter=filter("plugin", "mongo")  and (not filter("cluster", "*")) {{#filter}} and {{{filter}}}{{/filter}}, extrapolation="last_value", maxExtrapolations=2).mean(by=["host"])
TOTAL_NON_MAPPED_MEMORY = (TOTAL_VIRTUAl_MEMORY - TOTAL_MAPPED_MEMORY).scale(1024).scale(1024)

metrics.description: This metric shows total number of mongod page faults/sec. Darker colors indicate higher relative values.

job.template: TOTAL_PAGE_FAULTS_PER_SEC = data("counter.extra_info.page_faults", filter=filter("plugin", "mongo")  and (not filter("cluster", "*")) {{#filter}} and {{{filter}}}{{/filter}}, extrapolation="last_value", maxExtrapolations=2).mean(by=["host"])

metrics.description: This metric shows total number of queries performed/sec since last restart. Darker colors indicate higher relative values.

job.template: TOTAL_QUERIES_PER_SEC = data("counter.opcounters.query", filter=filter("plugin", "mongo")  and (not filter("cluster", "*")) {{#filter}} and {{{filter}}}{{/filter}}, extrapolation="last_value", maxExtrapolations=2).mean(by=["host"])

metrics.description: This metric shows total requests received by the server/sec. Darker colors indicate higher relative values.

job.template: TOTAL_REQUEST_PER_SEC = data("counter.network.numRequests", filter=filter("plugin", "mongo")  and (not filter("cluster", "*")) {{#filter}} and {{{filter}}}{{/filter}}, extrapolation="last_value", maxExtrapolations=2).mean(by=["host"])

metrics.description: This metric shows total amount of mongodb resident memory usage (bytes). Darker colors indicate higher relative values.

job.template: TOTAL_RESIDENT_MEMORY = data("gauge.mem.resident", filter=filter("plugin", "mongo")  and (not filter("cluster", "*")) {{#filter}} and {{{filter}}}{{/filter}}, extrapolation="last_value", maxExtrapolations=2).scale(1024).scale(1024).mean(by=["host"])

metrics.description: This metric shows total amount of memory allocated to collections for document storage (bytes). Darker colors indicate higher relative values.

job.template: TOTAL_STORAGE_SIZE = data("gauge.storageSize", filter=filter("plugin", "mongo")  and (not filter("cluster", "*")) {{#filter}} and {{{filter}}}{{/filter}}, extrapolation="last_value", maxExtrapolations=2).mean(by=["host"]).sum().scale(1024).scale(1024)

uiModel.o11ySignalflowTemplate: A = data('gauge.connections.current', filter=filter('plugin', 'mongo') and (not filter('cluster', '*')), extrapolation='last_value', maxExtrapolations=5).mean(by=['host']).count().publish(label='A')
